dogecoin.text:
Remember just because Doge makes front page news, doesn't make it a safer cryptocurrency. It doesn't use TLS 1.3 on the networks so beware if you connect to a mine, wallet or to transact you're opening your network up to ransomware...
#dogecoin
Hey, @dogecoin say uncle... Woof woof, TLS 1.3 or bust. Much wow

Every time I tweet about Doge security and ransomware attack vectors, @BTC and $Doge prices are like, beeeeeeeerrrrrrrrrrrrrwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwww... much wow. #dogecoin 

For the record, I do NOT hate crypto. I just think the Doge network needs to use TLS 1.3. Use a paper wallet. https://t.co/PaYbAVJ9Nk
